# origincloud_network_dns_policy_associations (Data Source)

Lists a VPC's DNS policy associations: none or one.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project` (String) The project whose dns policy associations to list.
- `region` (String) The region whose dns policy associations to list.
- `vpc` (String) The vpc whose dns policy associations to list.

### Read-Only

- `dns_policy_associations` (Attributes List) The dns policy associations listed, from every page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dns_policy_associations))

<a id="nestedatt--dns_policy_associations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dns_policy_associations`

Read-Only:

- `dns_policy` (String) The DNS policy the VPC relays through, in the VPC's project and region.
- `name` (String) The association's resource name. Its last segment is the DNS policy's id.
